# Data Source: okta_collections_resource

Retrieves a resource (an app, group, or push group) in a resource [Collection](https://developer.okta.com/docs/api/iga/openapi/governance.api/tag/Collections/), with the entitlements included for it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "okta_collections_resource" "example" {
  collection_id = "col1example2AbCdE1d7"
  id            = "res1example2AbCdE1d7"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection_id` (String) Unique identifier for the collection.
- `id` (String) The resource's ID within the collection (`resource_id` on `okta_collections_resource`).

### Read-Only

- `entitlements` (List of String) Entitlements included for this resource, one JSON-encoded object per element (use `jsondecode`).
- `labels` (List of String) The governance labels associated with this resource, one JSON-encoded object per element. See the note below.
- `push_groups` (List of String) Push groups associated with an app collection resource, one JSON-encoded object per element.
- `related_apps` (List of String) The apps related to this resource, one JSON-encoded object per element. See the note below.
- `resource_configuration` (Block) Server-resolved configuration details for this resource within the collection (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--resource_configuration)).
- `resource_id` (String) The unique ID for this resource within the collection.
- `resource_orn` (String) The ORN identifier for the resource (app, group, or push group).
- `resource_profile` (Block) A limited set of properties from the resource's profile (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--resource_profile)). See the note below.

~> **Note:** The API returns `labels`, `related_apps` and `resource_profile` only when they are requested with an `include` query parameter, which this data source doesn't send. They are currently always empty.

<a id="nestedblock--resource_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_configuration`

Read-Only:

- `counts` (Block) Counts of related items for this resource (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--resource_configuration--counts)).
- `entitlement_management_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Entitlement Management is enabled for this resource.
- `has_push_mapping` (Boolean) Whether this group resource has push group mappings to applications.
- `type` (String) The type of resource, for example `APPLICATION`.

<a id="nestedblock--resource_configuration--counts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_configuration.counts`

Read-Only:

- `entitlements` (Number) The number of entitlements included for this app resource in the collection.
- `labels` (Number) The number of governance labels associated with this resource.
- `push_groups` (Number) The number of push groups associated with this app resource in the collection.
- `related_apps` (Number) The number of related apps for this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--resource_profile"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_profile`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) The description of the resource.
- `id` (String) Okta resource instance ID.
- `label` (String) The label of the Okta app.
- `logo` (List of String) Logo links, one JSON-encoded object per element.
- `name` (String) The name of the Okta resource.
